status_vocabulary.UNIT_TESTED: logic verified by unit tests only; no runtime path
status_vocabulary.CAMPAIGN_INTEGRATED: wired into the production campaign graph and exercised through the real nodes/runtime
status_vocabulary.CAMPAIGN_DEMONSTRATED: campaign-integrated AND end-to-end demonstrated on a controlled live target with ground truth
status_vocabulary.INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED: validated on an operator-supplied independent holdout — NO capability holds this status
status_vocabulary.BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY: requires an external resource the project does not control

capabilities.capability: adaptive_research_loop (signal inventory + hypothesis generation + dedup + bounded iteration)
capabilities.runtime_path: graph/builder.py flag-gated research_loop node ahead of the strategist on six entry routes (validator/causal_research/disclosed_report_intel x2/attack_graph/vip_orchestrator/smart_campaigns_execution); flag-off = byte-comparable graph
capabilities.evidence: tests/test_umdr31_adaptive_research.py (27), test_umdr31_research_loop_integration.py (15), test_umdr31_campaign_e2e_ablation.py (8): full loop through the REAL research_loop + family_execution nodes against a live controlled target; the planner consumes the enriched pool; execution outcomes feed back
capabilities.limitations: demonstrated on one team-authored two-directory fixture under a constrained budget; NOT an independent holdout; no real-world recall/precision claim

capabilities.capability: coverage-gap signal consumption (ledger gaps -> planner hypotheses)
capabilities.runtime_path: the research_loop node's coverage channel (the SAME shared ledger projection the UM-DR-30 gap report uses)
capabilities.evidence: integration test 4 (strategist consumption); ablation coverage-only arm: 1 hypothesis generated where the baseline generates none
capabilities.limitations: class-shaped ledger keys do not reorder stateful execution (pool enrichment only — recorded as a deliberate design boundary, not a defect)

capabilities.capability: invariant-review signal consumption (candidate violations -> planner hypotheses + execution priority)
capabilities.runtime_path: the research_loop node's invariant channel + the family execution node's hint pass-through (loop-flag-gated)
capabilities.evidence: ablation invariant-only arm: under a 36-request ceiling the priority ordering reaches the ground-truth vulnerability the alphabetical baseline cannot; scope-denied invariants never become hypotheses (pinned)
capabilities.limitations: single-fixture population; the mechanism (ordering within the same budget) is general but the measured delta is fixture-specific

capabilities.runtime_path: deterministic uuid5 ids -> the merge_hypotheses upsert; closed pool entries never regenerate
capabilities.evidence: unit tests 2-3: fingerprint stability, security-relevant-difference preservation (principals/state/objectives never wrongly merged), conclusively-rejected/promoted never repeated, semantic invariant-covers-observation dedup
capabilities.limitations: fingerprints cover the loop's own deterministic templates; foreign-origin hypotheses are not fingerprint-reconciled (out of scope by design)

capabilities.capability: stateful research-priority hints (planner -> authorized stateful execution)
capabilities.runtime_path: family_execution node -> run_stateful_discovery: deterministic case reordering within the SAME budget, scope and authority
capabilities.evidence: E2E + ablation: hints applied=True arms reach the ground truth under the tight budget; research_hints_applied reported in the summary; flag-off keeps UM-DR-28 behavior byte-stable (regression test)
capabilities.limitations: ordering only — no budget/scope/authority change; derives exclusively from observed workflow boundaries

capabilities.capability: independent holdout validation of the research loop
capabilities.evidence: no operator-supplied holdout corpus exists; the Charter thresholds (M10: recall >= 0.5 AND precision >= 0.7 on an independent population) are unchanged and remain unmet-by-evidence
capabilities.limitations: the single most important open item; no recall/precision claim beyond the fixture is made anywhere in this release
